title: 第9章 见了主人就是这种态度第10章 每个人都有每个人的舔狗
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
闻言，季月差点笑出声来，“那我们低声些，你与主人我说说，你和你的茵茵妹妹的事。”
沈宴静默半晌，还是说了：“我当时是出任务，路过岐山那边听到女子的呼叫声，我过去一看，发现是茵茵被发狂的妖兽袭击，我出手救下她，后来、”
“停。”季月打住沈宴的话。
“合欢宗的人向来都是两人以上出行，她们绝不会单独行动，她若是实力弱怎敢出门跑到一群妖兽面前送死？”
沈宴也不是傻的，脑子一转就明白了过来季月的意思，他否决道：
“茵茵心地善良，你少小人之心度君子之腹了，她岂会为了你的灵根而伤害自己…”
说到后头，他自己都说不下去了，甚至诧异自己会下意识想要维护云茵。
不过念头只出现了几秒，沈宴眼神迷离了一下，然后就生气的看向季月：
“茵茵是我喜欢的人，你就是嫉妒她，嫉妒我喜欢她，所以你要挑拨离间我们的关系。”
【姐独自美丽：你试探没有用的，剧情就是会自我修复，书中现在除了你和女主，都是可控的。】
“我嫉妒没有用的东西干什么。”
季月神色略显遗憾，落在沈宴眼中就是被伤到心的失落，他忽略了季月的话，想先顺着季月，毕竟茵茵来天山宗后修炼得需要很多资源。
他放柔了嗓音：“月月，我去影洞时被毒虫咬了一口，现在手还疼。”
季月装作听不懂的样子，转身就走：“疼就去找大夫开药，我又不是药，能给你止痛。”
既然变数只有她和女主，她脑海灵光一闪而过。
接下来，季月命令沈宴天不亮起来去山脚卖早点的地方蹲着，必须买到清晨第一份吃食。
否则就让他当着全弟子院的人大声喊“我是季月的狗！”
沈宴觉得季月有病，但敢怒不敢言。
他当然不会真听季月的话，凭借他修为，上下山来回不过一炷香的功夫，他天亮时出门足矣。
可鸡未叫时，沈宴被几个人推搡醒了。

“沈师弟，别睡了，季师姐让你办事呢。”
沈宴睡得正香，被人叫醒很不爽，睁眼一看还是几个不熟悉的人，便理都没理就闭上眼继续睡。
几人凑近沈宴的耳旁，悄声说：“沈师弟，季师姐还托我们给你带话，‘你也不想大家知道你给我当什么吧?’”
“！”
忽地，沈宴就没瞌睡了，起身穿衣一气呵成。
几人没有离开，而是一路跟着沈宴。
他们就是之前陪季月去临县的人，季月早知沈宴会耍花招，就花了钞能力找他们帮忙盯着。
季月说监督沈宴起床就行，但他们觉得钱赚得太简单，内心拿着不安，商议一番一致决定寸步不离的盯着沈宴。
沈宴将买好的吃食送到月华居，正准备走，季月叫住他。
“沈宴，你见了主人就是这种态度？连个尾巴都不知道摇一下？”
闻言，沈宴庆幸跟着他的人得知去处是月华院时就离开了，不然被传出去，他一个大男人就身败名裂了。
“季月，你不要太过分了！”
季月双手环于胸前，表情幽幽的不说话。
好一会儿，天亮了，第一道金光照耀在屋顶的瓦片上，弟子院集体的窸窸窣窣的起床声响传到月华院中。
沈宴妥协了，对季月‘礼貌’道：“晨安。”
content_en:
Hearing this, Ji Yue almost laughed out loud, "Then let's keep our voices low. You and I will tell the master about you and your sister Yin Yin."
Shen Yan was silent for a long time, and then said: "I was on a mission at the time. I heard a woman's cry when passing by Qishan Mountain. I went over and took a look and found that it was Yin Yin who was attacked by a crazy monster. I rescued her. Later,"
"Stop." Ji Yue stopped Shen Yan.
"People from the Hehuan Sect always travel in two or more. They will never travel alone. If she is weak, how dare she go out and die in front of a group of monsters?"
Shen Yan was not stupid. He understood what Ji Yue meant in a flash of his mind. He objected:
"Yin Yin is kind-hearted. You are too young to judge a gentleman. How could she harm herself for the sake of your spiritual roots..."
When it came to the latter part, he couldn't say anything anymore, and was even surprised that he would subconsciously want to defend Yun Yin.
However, the thought only appeared for a few seconds. Shen Yan's eyes were blurred for a moment, and then he looked at Ji Yue angrily:
"Yinyin is the person I like, but you are jealous of her and jealous that I like her, so you want to sow discord between us."
[Sister Alone and Beautiful: It’s useless for you to test, the plot will repair itself. Now in the book, except for you and the heroine, everyone is controllable. 】
"I'm jealous of what useless things do."
Ji Yue looked slightly regretful, which was a heartbreaking loss in Shen Yan's eyes. He ignored Ji Yue's words and wanted to follow Ji Yue first. After all, Yin Yin's cultivation after coming to Tianshan Sect required a lot of resources.
He softened his voice: "Yueyue, I was bitten by a poisonous insect when I went to Shadow Cave, and my hand still hurts."
Ji Yue pretended not to understand, turned around and left: "If it hurts, go to the doctor to prescribe medicine. I am not a medicine. I can give you pain relief."
Since the only variables were her and the heroine, an idea flashed through her mind.
Next, Ji Yue ordered Shen Yan to get up before dawn and squat at the breakfast place at the foot of the mountain. He had to buy the first meal in the morning.
Otherwise, let him shout loudly in front of everyone in the disciples' academy, "I am Ji Yue's dog!"
Shen Yan felt that Ji Yue was sick, but he dared not say anything in anger.
Of course he would not really listen to Ji Yue's words. With his cultivation, it only took a stick of incense to go up and down the mountain. It was enough for him to go out at dawn.
But before the rooster crowed, Shen Yan was pushed awake by several people.
"Junior Brother Shen, don't sleep. Senior Sister Ji has asked you to do something."
Shen Yan was sleeping soundly and was unhappy to be woken up. When he opened his eyes, he saw a few unfamiliar people, so he ignored them and closed his eyes and continued to sleep.
Several people came close to Shen Yan's ears and whispered: "Junior Brother Shen, Senior Sister Ji also asked us to bring you a message, 'You don't want everyone to know what you do to me, right?'"
"!"
Suddenly, Shen Yan stopped sleeping and got up and dressed in one go.
A few people did not leave, but followed Shen Yan all the way.
They were the people who had accompanied Ji Yue to Linxian County before. Ji Yue had known that Shen Banquet was playing tricks, so he spent all his money to find them to help keep an eye on them.
Ji Yue said that it would be enough to supervise Shen Yan when he got up, but they felt that it was too easy to make money and felt uneasy. After some discussion, they decided to keep an eye on Shen Yan.
Shen Yan delivered the purchased food to Yuehuaju and was about to leave when Ji Yue stopped him.
"Shen Yan, is this your attitude when you meet the master? You don't even know how to wag your tail?"
Hearing this, Shen Yan was glad that the people who followed him left when they found out that they were going to Yuehuayuan. Otherwise, if the news spread, he, a grown man, would be ruined.
"Ji Yue, don't go too far!"
Ji Yue folded her hands on her chest with a gloomy expression and said nothing.
After a while, it dawned. The first golden light shone on the tiles on the roof, and the rustling sound of the disciples getting up was heard in Yuehua Courtyard.
Shen Yan compromised and said politely to Ji Yue, "Good morning."
